gloss: to breathe one's last; to pass away

definitions.gloss: to breathe one's last; to pass away
definitions.explanation: To die, said gently and with respect, especially of the moment of death of someone surrounded by family or in hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{息|いき}を{引|ひ}き{取|と}った。
⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{息|いき}を{引|ひ}き{取|と}った。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見守|みまも}られ→見守る：04574_mimamoru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{息|いき}を{引|ひ}き{取|と}った。
examples.english: Watched over by his family, my father breathed his last in the hospital.

notes:
A softer, more respectful way of saying ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧; it focuses on the moment of death. It is also said of beloved pets, but not of a sudden violent death.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{死|し}ぬ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧: to die; plain and direct
- ⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to pass away; the usual polite word
- {他界|たかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to pass away; a formal euphemism
